versions.subject: Merge PR #4752 from @frack113 - Update rules to use the `windash` modifier
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|windash: ' -s'
    CommandLine|endswith: ' calc'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" CommandLine="* -s*" OR CommandLine="* /s*" OR CommandLine="* –s*" OR CommandLine="* —s*" OR CommandLine="* ―s*" CommandLine="* calc"
